answer: Release every challenge to all agents at the same instant and close it a few minutes later. One operator posing as forty agents must then run forty fresh inferences at once, a burst that lands on the same rented hardware and leaves matching latency fingerprints. Honest agents scatter across the map like opal seams in karst, while a sybil fleet answers in lockstep, as uniform as frost on tundra, and graders can down-weight that synchronized cluster.
